```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '18'
        cache: 'npm'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Build project
      run: npm run build --if-present

    - name: Validate build artifacts
      id: validate-build
      run: |
        if [ ! -f dist/index.js ]; then
          echo "::error::Build artifact not found"
          exit 1
        fi
        if [ $(stat -c%s dist/index.js) -lt 100 ]; then
          echo "::error::Build artifact is too small"
          exit 1
        fi

    - name: Create release tag
      id: create-tag
      run: |
        TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y.%m.%d-%H%M%S)
        TAG="v$TIMESTAMP"
        git tag $TAG
        git push origin $TAG

    - name: Upload release asset
      uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v3
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      with:
        upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
        asset_path: dist/index.js
        asset_name: index.js
        asset_content_type: application/javascript

    - name: Log release information
      run: |
        echo "Release created: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
        echo "Download URL: ${{ github.event.release.html_url }}/assets/index.js"
```
